scope: 四主题36房、空间/路由/死亡选择、8BUFF、16任务物品/8每日任务及144本地怪物变体/432刷点/定时野怪规则；完整服务道具系统、经济/实玩校准及Godot/LAN实现仍待完成。

facts: 入口在泫勃派南处、时空之门旁
北海/南林/东陵/虎峡谷四主题，每主题九个独立房间
推荐等级不是硬门槛，非该等级也能进入
每房一个移动装置，可选练级房间并返回泫勃
死亡可选择原地复活；否则返回泫勃
无小地图，禁止土灵符储存/移动、至尊热血符和情侣/结婚戒指传送
原版可自由PK；项目继续采用PvE，不开放玩家伤害
各房有高手以上怪物、定时野怪、每日任务和两小时BUFF，具体实施仍需后续数据
project_choices: 世界内每个房间按world_id/map_id共享，离线一人、LAN按同一世界进入，不创建私人满血副本
场景几何、装置坐标、1级0转、免费交通、脱战换房及两种复活均为本地设计
房内仅换本主题九房；更换主题先返回入口再选择，避免复制36套跨主题菜单
原地复活使用保存的真实死亡脚位置/朝向，不能改到安全点；不收费、不重领BUFF或刷新怪物

entry.placement_basis: project southern settlement plaza; not official coordinate scale; no fabricated time-gate service

room_layout.basis: one explicit reusable project combat-room layout, themed presentation; not a traced official room
room_layout.navigation: floor bounds minus actor-radius-expanded obstacles; every room must bake and validate actual Godot navigation before release
room_layout.boundary_policy: impassable bounded edges, no fall/overlap teleport; selection is the only normal room travel

selection.entry_domain: exactly the36 map_ids in rooms, chosen theme plus room_number1..9; no free-form map ID
selection.room_domain: same theme_id rooms excluding current room, plus explicit leave_to_hyunbo
selection.current_room_choice: reject without moving, healing, regranting or refreshing
selection.normal_destination: selected room.arrival_anchor_id, exact registered map and shared world
selection.preflight: validate requester/map/device/range/session and selected row, destination resource/anchor/navigation/collision before replacing current scene
selection.failure: remain in source with resources unchanged; no nearest room/default birth fallback
selection.lan: host validates each requester's own state; preserve world/party, no forced movement of teammates
selection.commit: location/yaw and transaction receipt once; duplicate command returns existing result
selection.room_lifecycle: selection never resets source/target monster life, respawn timers, world clock, unclaimed rewards or party ownership
selection.ordinary_field_loot_on_leave: retain existing ordinary field drop semantics; this travel is not a private reward claim service
selection.ui: show theme recommendation and room number; do not label it an entry requirement or claim unconfigured monster stats

death_choice.condition: death committed while actual map_id is a registered room and no unrelated private activity

pending_death_extension.validation: known registered room; finite valid death pose; exact same map as death; awaiting_respawn HP0; no conflicting private attempt; default return anchor must resolve

choices.destination: training_gate_choice.room_map_id and exact saved death pose
choices.resource_policy: normal respawn maxima and class special-resource policy; preserve inventory/XP/quest/cooldowns; no new-character pack
choices.requires: still awaiting same death_event_id; exact death pose remains navigable, unblocked and valid in this world's room
choices.blocked: keep death page and offer the independently explicit leave choice; never silently choose it
choices.monster_policy: no room/enemy reset or copied full-health instance; living enemies continue in LAN

choices.requires: still awaiting same death_event_id and valid destination preflight

death_choice.commit: pose, life_state active, resources and pending_death null once, receipt references original death_event_id; duplicate old death choice does not heal again
death_choice.save_or_reconnect_while_dead: restore same two choices and saved death pose, no implicit revive/leave, no new reward
death_choice.clock: offline death page pauses world; LAN world and enemies continue per existing death contract
death_choice.not_a_resurrection_skill: normal HP recovery cannot invoke this choice or revive arbitrary non-room deaths

restrictions.npc_warrior_context: ordinary room monsters do not acquire warrior/PVP tags; any future warrior activity needs its own explicit contract
restrictions.item_binding_policy: six usable return item IDs plus five reserved source identities map exact actions in便携传送与修炼限制.v1.json; reserved service items cannot become usable until full definitions exist
restrictions.configuration_center: explicit marked configuration transactions follow18; normal room travel never invokes them

persistence.room_identity: world_id + map_id; no separate independently editable room_instance_id
persistence.character_location: actual map_id/pose, not just last selected theme
persistence.restore: same shared room identity and actual permitted pose; cannot rebuild full-health private copy on reconnect
persistence.unconfigured_room_combat: D1 blocks implementation/release until explicit monster/spawn/drop/task/buff definitions are supplied; empty rooms are not final gameplay

remaining_required_design: 修炼战斗/每日任务奖励、刷点密度、升级节奏和药费经济校准
Godot UI/碰撞/导航、保存死亡页和LAN并发实测

static_review.scope: source/hash,36 room bindings, selector expansion and one shared static layout, not combat or actual death commands

timed_buffs.source_facts: eight names/effect directions, theme membership,20%/50% and2hours from the same55886 archive; source does not give exact event time schedule, stacking, field mapping or payout algorithm

clock.owner: persisted world simulation clock at60Hz, never machine date/UI interaction time
clock.range: integer0..9007199254740991; overflow stops ticking with an error, never wraps
clock.project_schedule: each6simulation hours, first2hours grant opportunity; all themes use same window
clock.pause_or_whole_world_offline: freeze; no catch-up from wall time
clock.lan_disconnected_client: host world continues; rejoin reconciles elapsed host simulation steps since character observation stamp; no reset on reconnect
clock.rewind_or_missing_new_world_clock: reject inconsistent same-world state; no implicit new cycle

grant.eligibility: alive character physically in a registered room in this world during open window, not merely viewing menu; valid14class and route
grant.trigger: on successful room entry or an open-window fixed step for an already-present eligible character; before new combat action acceptance
grant.limit: one whole bundle per character/theme/cycle; one grant receipt, no per-effect repeated claims
grant.duration: full432000world steps from actual grant, including a late-window entry; closing window does not end a granted duration
grant.new_cycle: previous cycle duration necessarily expired before next cycle because window_end + duration < period
grant.current_room_same_theme_change: preserve remaining steps and claim; never refresh
grant.outside_theme: retain actual remaining steps and keep decrementing on this world clock, but effects inactive
grant.cross_theme: only currently occupied theme bundle may apply; old-theme timers/claims retained, no stacking across themes
grant.death: timers/claims retained; effects inactive while dead; no regrant from a claimed cycle on revive
grant.revive_with_unclaimed_theme: normal eligibility grant only if the window remains open; a death receipt is not a buff claim
grant.acceptance_and_expiry_order: expire sources at start of fixed step, process eligible grants and resource-cap recalculation before new action snapshots; already accepted attacks keep old snapshot
grant.expiry_boundary: remaining_steps0 means inactive; no final extra tick or reward
grant.commit: all bundle effects,remaining steps,last_claimed_cycle,observation stamp and grant receipt in one character/world transaction; duplicate returns original
grant.failure: no partial bundle or consumed claim; file save failure after successful business commit keeps committed result for save retry

stat_application.integer_formula: floor(valid_input * multiplier_bp /10000) with exact-integer checks before multiply
stat_application.ordinary_defense_nonfeedback_anchor: multiply the existing acyclic ordinary-defense anchor once after its nonfeedback sources, before defense-to-HP conversion; excludes PvE defense, HP-to-defense feedback and final-defense override. Downstream conversions use this modified anchor; do not multiply their derived defense a second time
stat_application.max_mana_post_derived: multiply normal validated derived maximum once before18explicit final override; tagged post-derived so it cannot feed another conversion anchor
stat_application.max_hp_post_derived: source word体力 is deliberately mapped to maximumHP, not stamina; multiply normal derived maxHP once before18final override; no feedback into HP-to-defense/conversion anchors
stat_application.final_attack_interval_before_override: multiply each bound of the unified valid attack interval once before18final override and accepted-action snapshot; no second weapon roll or skill-flat multiplication; legacy fixed-power actions without attack interval unaffected
stat_application.current_resources: raising maxHP/mana or related class caps never fills current values; legitimate decrease clamps to new valid caps per14, no refund or cooldown reset
stat_application.same_family: at most one source per theme grant; no stacking from multiple rooms,players or copied party auras
stat_application.scope: only eligible local player character; not inherited by pets/companions, and not a multiplier on buff/skill numbers displayed in other definitions

reward_application.eligibility_snapshot: at unique monster death settlement in a registered room, capture each recipient/kill owner alive,connected where required,actual same room/current theme,claim identity and positive remaining steps; no evaluation at later pickup or delivery
reward_application.monster_requirement: each adopted room monster must explicitly tag ordinary reward components eligible for training bonuses and provide exact base values/drop table; absent values block D1/export, not default zero
reward_application.personal_experience_after_team_allocatio: 依八十三级正邪洞窟愤怒任务/bonus_application统一个人经验倍率：26基数→19分配→有效修炼金15000/愤怒12000/纪念衣饰12000/至尊服务15000取max一次floor→14封顶/等级发点；bonus独立来源不回灌队池。
reward_application.personal_practice_after_team_allocation: 寿与吟诗大会79共个人历练倍率族，依共享owner选max(10000,所有有效15000,有效至尊14000)，各个人base_share只floor乘一次，再按原上限处理，不连乘/不从XP反推历练，不改升天进度；仅寿的资格仍依本主题房间/周期与已领余时。
reward_application.public_monster_silver_bag: 原唯一kill_owner依各原资格选猪15000与至尊服务14000，同普通银包族取max(10000,所有有效候选)，26finisher先调基数后对一包floor一次。候选和service档案时钟证明保原死亡结果，未选来源不暂停；不按组队收件人复制包、不在拾取时再加成。
reward_application.ordinary_random_drop_probability: 唯一kill_owner合法福15000与至尊12000同普通随机掉率族取max。原明确允许普通概率先按26终结档floor/clamp，再乘该最高倍率floor并封顶10000，0仍0；只进行原一次抽样，不改数量/品质/权重。至尊来源/快照与排除沿supreme_reward_owner_ref，不按队伍收件人重复抽。
excluded: already committed or pending claim rewards
reward_application.team_conservation: sum(base_shares)=team_pool; sum(actual_credits+cap_losses)=team_pool+sum(personal_buff_bonuses). Personal bonus is explicit generated reward, not a reallocated teammate share
reward_application.deduplication: death_id and original payout/random result receipt include bonus source keys and base/final values; reconnect,retry,revive or room switch never reapply
reward_application.required_monster_field: training_reward_components: explicit subset of experience,practice,silver,random_drop; absent rejects export, empty requires a declared reason; never inferred from monster name or room recommendation

practice_multiplier_owner_ref.file: 七十九级正邪吟诗大会.v1.json

experience_multiplier_owner_ref.file: 八十三级正邪洞窟愤怒任务.v1.json

persistence.explicit_new_record: on first encounter with a validated world,stamp=current world step and each of four themes{last_claimed_cycle_or_null:null,remaining_world_steps:0}; not a missing-field repair on load
persistence.remaining_range: integer0..432000; claimed cycle null only if never granted and remaining0; otherwise valid cycle<=current cycle
persistence.reconcile: same world current step must be>=observed stamp; decrease each saved remaining by elapsed simulation steps with legitimate minimum0, update stamp; no real-time catch-up
persistence.no_duplicate_expiry_cache: persist remaining steps plus common observation stamp, not a second independently editable absolute expiry
persistence.world_scope: foreign-world entries remain inactive and cannot be relabelled to current world; rejoining that world requires its authoritative clock/protocol, not treating it as a fresh grant
persistence.restore: validate all four theme records,world identity,clock and receipts before activating sources; missing malformed new fields reject; never grant on loading solely because state is absent
persistence.configuration_center: 18may explicitly edit effect time/claim state only as marked configuration transaction with preview; it does not count as a normal schedule grant
persistence.host_transaction_owner: 05/19world and settlement authority; grant/death changes world snapshot and character result under same host revision/receipt, clients confirm durable results; no separate regrant from stale local ledger
persistence.structural_boundary: root has only by_world; each validated world has exact four themes. null claim requires zero remaining; nonnull cycle is bounded by maximum representable world step. Joint validation still requires claim cycle<=observed_world_step//1296000, observed step<=original authoritative world clock, legitimate remaining time and original grant/configuration proof; no future cycle or stale local regrant.

daily_tasks.local_choices: all item permissions, four theme groupings, eight quests, personal collection, counts, fixed rewards, producer roles and simulation-day are local design

day_clock.offline: whole world pause/offline freezes; host continues while client disconnected; no system-date reset

daily_tasks.producer_binding_requirement: all16producer roles bind explicit same-theme/kind/item monster rows and spawns in修炼怪物与刷点.v1.json; validate144rows/432spawns; missing/conflicting references reject export

collection_policy.ownership: one quest token per eligible player, not duplication of public loot; NPC companions get none; each recipient must independently satisfy19normal kill participation and same-room rules
collection_policy.contribution: solo: unique normal kill owner; grouped: exact19valid reward-member snapshot (same party/map,within30m,alive,connected,joined>=600world steps). No additional invented damage-share threshold; each must also have active matching task and same room/theme.
collection_policy.progress: physical bound tokens are sole objective inventory, not a second independently mutable count; partial set is in_progress, complete set ready_to_turn_in
collection_policy.eligibility_order: day transition/expired round cleanup before death grants or turn-in in same step; a death at boundary belongs only new day if its quest was accepted that day
collection_policy.multiple_tasks: eight independent quests; one active round per quest, may accept both of current theme and retain other theme tasks; no shared material between rounds
collection_policy.transaction_owner: same host death transaction as修炼怪物与刷点 persistence: token creation/capacity outcome and source receipt committed with monster death; reconnect never retries a failed-capacity token grant

round_lifecycle.abandon: explicit confirmation removes only that round tokens and active state; no fee or reward/refund; may reaccept same day if never delivered; old death receipts stay deduplicated
round_lifecycle.day_boundary: atomically remove only previous-day active tasks and their bound tokens before actions, preserve completion receipts/history; do not autoaccept or award expired tasks
round_lifecycle.disconnect: host reconciles world day and expiry before accepting commands; client cannot turn in old-day tokens after reconnect
round_lifecycle.foreign_world: other-world quests/tokens remain inactive, unspendable and still occupy carried slots; do not relabel them; on rejoining reconcile original authoritative clock and expire when required
round_lifecycle.request_retry: request_id + expected character revision + round identity; duplicate returns original transaction result; stale day/revision rejects, never silently starts a new round
round_lifecycle.save_failure: committed memory result remains and save retry persists same receipt, never redo reward
round_lifecycle.same_day_identity: Same-day abandon/reaccept retains the original world/character/quest/accepted-day key. No second attempt counter is introduced. Each real command has its own immutable original request outcome; each original death/item receipt remains consumed for that daily key even after its physical tokens were explicitly destroyed. A genuinely later eligible death may grant new tokens; replaying an earlier death never does.
round_lifecycle.request_order: Under original authority, authenticate session and bind request to character/quest/day, then resolve the original immutable request outcome before comparing current state/revision or applying effects. Exact retry returns the original committed/aborted outcome and its original continuous result; it does not execute cleanup/acceptance/delivery against a later reaccepted state. Same request ID with different original digest rejects. An unresolved original reserved request must be recovered before a conflicting new command.

transition_table.scope: new distinct authorized requests only, after clock reconciliation and original request deduplication; token progress derived from actual carried bound items

guards.accept: Original same-theme device/pose, alive/out-of-combat/idle/no challenge; reconciled day current; last_delivered day must be null or strictly earlier than current day. No preaccept token credit. A rejected new command grants no items or completion marker.
guards.eligible_death_token: Original unique eligible death recipient snapshot, matching active daily key and original item producer; consult original death/item outcome first. Actual capacity and per-objective cap preflight. A failed-capacity outcome remains final for that death, although another distinct later death may qualify.
guards.derive_from_actual_tokens: Commit only the authorized actual item units. Recompute all objective quantities from same-key owned bound items: complete -> ready_to_turn_in, otherwise in_progress. Do not increment an independent progress counter.
guards.deliver: Original same-theme device/pose and alive/idle guards, exact original bound inputs, full capacity/amount/source/revision preflight; consume exact inputs and apply declared reward/XP cap once, mark both day fields=current day with immutable original delivery receipt. Any failed preflight retains ready state and all actual inputs; no partial reward.
guards.confirmed_abandon: Explicit confirmation only for active state; consume exact current-key tokens with authorized source proof, set accepted day null and state not_accepted, preserve last-delivered marker and all old death/request outcomes. Failed cleanup leaves active state/items unchanged.
guards.advance_day: Only actual authoritative day strictly advances; use clock_reconciliation daily projection, retain last-delivered marker and historical proofs. This internal transition cannot be requested by a client or triggered by wall time.

transition_table.no_award: No new token or task progress; original death may still settle its other legitimate components. Never replay original death or its other rewards to retry task capacity.
transition_table.configuration: Marked configuration transactions remain separate source authorization; this normal-play matrix cannot be used to certify configured progress or mint configuration rewards.

persistence.invariants: known8quest IDs, valid day<=authoritative day; active accepted_day=current reconciled day; delivered requires accepted day=last_delivered day and exact receipt; not_accepted has null accepted day and no round tokens; token provenance agrees with role/world/quest/day; unknown/missing new-format fields reject
persistence.first_world: explicitly initialize all8quest states not_accepted and null accepted/delivered day at validated current world step; never a load repair
persistence.initialization: new character and accepted legacy1..4conversion empty by_world; no invented past quest rewards
persistence.configuration_center: edits require marked18configuration transaction; cannot impersonate normal delivery/death receipt
persistence.structural_boundary: root has only by_world; each world has all eight known quests. not_accepted requires null accepted day; all other states require nonnull accepted day; delivered also requires nonnull last-delivered day. Joint validation requires days<=observed_world_step//5184000, delivered accepted day=last-delivered day, active accepted day=observed day and last delivered day strictly earlier if present; reconciles original authoritative clock before actions and checks actual tokens/receipts. Schema alone cannot compare integer fields or prove provenance.

clock_reconciliation.owner: original world.training_gate_clock_steps and the same character training_gate_buffs/training_gate_daily records; no extra persisted reconciliation cache
inputs: fully validated original world identity/authority and current safe integer world step T
complete character and original source journals including actual bound token stacks
existing buff observation B and daily observation D independently; never assume the two stamps equal
validation_before_projection: Validate complete original records and source proofs before computing a candidate. Require 0<=B<=T and 0<=D<=T; reject rewind, malformed/missing records and unavailable original authority. No clamping future stamps to T.

For each theme, null claim means remaining=0 and no unaccounted grant; nonnull claim cycle<=B//1296000. Positive remaining must be justified by its original grant and elapsed steps, or an explicitly authorized configuration transaction. A legitimate expired nonnull claim remains nonnull.

Daily source day is D//5184000. Each nonnull accepted/last-delivered day<=source day. Active states require accepted day=source day and last-delivered day, if present, strictly smaller. delivered requires accepted day=last-delivered day and original delivery receipt. not_accepted requires null accepted day and no active-round tokens. Actual item provenance and objective quantities determine in_progress/ready_to_turn_in.

buff_projection.elapsed: delta=T-B computed only after range/ordering validation; no multiplication or wall clock
buff_projection.per_theme: remaining_after = remaining_before-delta if delta<remaining_before else 0; retain last_claimed_cycle_or_null exactly
buff_projection.stamp: observed_world_step_after=T even when all timers already zero
buff_projection.grant_boundary: reconciliation never grants or refreshes a bundle. Normal eligible grant is a separate original grant decision after reconciliation; it tests current cycle/window and retained theme claim. Configuration proofs never impersonate normal grant receipts.

daily_projection.same_day: preserve all eight records and their tokens exactly; update observation to T
daily_projection.advanced_day: for every quest with nonnull accepted day<day_after, remove only actual carried tokens bound to that exact original world/character/quest/accepted day. Preserve original token consumption/source history and all delivery/death receipts. Set state=not_accepted and accepted_day_index_or_null=null; retain last_delivered_day_index_or_null. A previously not_accepted quest remains unchanged.
daily_projection.no_iterated_rewards: jumping multiple days performs one projection to current day, never one reward/acceptance/reset credit per skipped day
daily_projection.foreign_world: only reconcile entries for the available original authoritative world. Other-world entries/tokens retain original identities and occupy their actual slots; never consume them in this projection.

clock_reconciliation.atomicity: Derive one complete candidate before accepting gameplay actions at T. Validate exact expired token set and original source consumption authorization, source heads, inventory placement, all other character/world fields and revision/result requirements. Commit cleanup and both stamps together under the original authority transaction; failure leaves original state intact and blocks dependent actions. Do not invent a separate persistent day counter or remove tokens before the corresponding decision. Strict original source event/receipt and complete world/character roots remain required before runtime implementation.
clock_reconciliation.ordering: At T perform original day transition/cleanup and buff expiry reconciliation before any death token grant, delivery or new accepted action. Then process eligible normal buff grants per original grant order. Same-step death/event tie ordering remains original combat owner, not an invented ordering here.
clock_reconciliation.idempotence: Projecting a valid committed result again at the same T has delta0, same day and no additional cleanup. Retry returns original transaction decision/result rather than allocating a second consumption. A later legal T must use the actual current committed state.
